cases.situation: I'm the hiring manager. Need to reject Daniel, a finalist for our senior marketing role. He was great, but the other candidate has B2B SaaS experience. I called him, now I need the follow-up email.
cases.reply: Hi Daniel, thanks again for the time you gave us, especially the launch plan you presented on Thursday, which the team is still talking about. As I said on the phone, we've offered the role to another candidate whose background is in B2B SaaS, which is where most of this role's work sits. It was a close decision. If we open the consumer marketing lead role in the spring, I'd like to contact you first, if you're open to that. Best, Farah
cases.note: Only offer the spring role if it's real; a door left open falsely is worse than none.

cases.situation: 手上有两个offer，决定去另一家了，要拒绝这家的HR张女士。面试时跟他们的李总聊得很好，不想把关系弄僵。
cases.reply: 张女士您好，非常感谢您和团队这段时间的安排，特别是和李总聊产品规划的那一轮，是我这次求职里收获最大的一次面试。经过慎重考虑，我决定接受另一家公司的offer，那个岗位和我接下来几年想做的方向更贴近。这个决定并不容易。希望以后还有机会合作，也祝团队一切顺利。
cases.note: 理由真实但简短，不说对方哪里不好，点名感谢具体的人。

cases.situation: J'ai refusé une offre dans une agence à Lyon. La DRH, Claire, m'a rappelé pour proposer 5 000 euros de plus. Ma décision n'a rien à voir avec le salaire, j'ai choisi un poste en télétravail.
cases.reply: Merci beaucoup, Claire, c'est une vraie proposition et j'y suis sensible. Ma décision ne tient pas à la rémunération mais au format du poste, donc je la maintiens. Merci encore à vous et à l'équipe pour votre accueil, j'espère qu'on se recroisera.
cases.note: Answer the counter once and honestly; saying it isn't about money closes the second round.

cases.situation: I'm in the final round for a data analyst role at Brightline Energy, panel is this Thursday. My current company just offered me the internal transfer I've wanted for a year and I've accepted. The recruiter is Nadia.
cases.reply:
Hi Nadia,
Thank you for the time you and the team have put into this, especially the conversation with Tom about the grid forecasting work, which I really enjoyed. I want to tell you early rather than late: I'm withdrawing from the process, so please do release Thursday's panel slot. I've accepted an internal move at my current company that I've been working toward for a while, and it wouldn't be fair to keep taking your team's time. I'd be glad to stay in touch.
Best,
Priya
cases.note: Withdraw before the panel, not after it: the decision by the second sentence, the true reason in one line, and freeing the slot as the practical ask.
